preset.description: One of the preset pipelines defined in PipelineManager::CompileAll. Defines a bunch of common pipeline properties and somethings that aren't easily represented in JSON.

vertexShader.description: Asset ID of the vertex shader. Vertex input state is automatically generated from this shader.

fragmentShader.description: Asset ID of the fragment shader.

blendMode.description: Blend modes are defined in pipelines.cpp

depthStencilState.description: Extremely basic depth options. I don't know if we'll need more than this.
